title: Nursing student found dead in vacant lot in Oriental Mindoro
summary: A 20-year-old female nursing student was found dead in a vacant lot along a poorly-lit section of a barangay road in Barangay Sapul, Calapan City, Oriental Mindoro, early Saturday.
